user.title: Connect OpenClaw
user.description: Pair with OpenClaw, then choose its Conversation entity in an Assist pipeline. Keep existing HA STT/TTS or select the optional OpenClaw speech entities. Credentials stay on the platform that owns the provider.

data_description.url: Base gateway URL, for example https://openclaw.example. Use HTTPS across untrusted networks. No token or password in this field.
data_description.pairing_code: Issue a short-lived one-use code with the companion plugin pairing.issue admin action. Never enter a Gateway admin token or provider key.
data_description.session_mode: Persistent shares the selected OC history; fresh creates separate history per HA conversation. Neither disables normal agent memory.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Optional native Assist tools for exposed entities. Other OpenClaw tools are governed separately by its agent policy.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair OpenClaw again
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new pairing code in OpenClaw to restore this connection.

reconfigure.title: Update OpenClaw address
reconfigure.description: Change the address without replacing entities or credentials. It must identify the same backend and agent. Reauthenticate separately if pairing was revoked.

error.legacy_identity_required: Reconnect at the original address first to establish identity, then use Reconfigure to move the address.

init.title: Conversation and device control
init.description: Choose Device control to let the agent use Home Assistant’s native Assist tools and exposed entities. Other tools granted to the OpenClaw agent are managed separately. History changes apply to new conversations.
